_about: The one rules version per section that both the calculation (eda_*.py) and the figures (*_figures.R, via the plot specs) implement, plus the shared rules s1.0 that the three sections use. Each current entry binds the Markdown rules (file, sha256) and the machine YAML (yaml, yaml_sha256); a module entry also names its shared rules and its output_version, the one version string that pages, section json, run record and frozen copy use. run_modules.py refuses to run when a file's SHA-256 differs from this manifest, copies this folder into _engine and records `sections` in run_record.json. `history` keeps every superseded revision with its original SHA-256; superseded files stay in this folder unchanged. To adopt a new revision: add the files, move the current entry to history with status superseded, change the code to match, and run the tests (test_rules_revision.py reads the YAML). An `edition` changes only the wording of a current Markdown file (one text instead of layers); the version, the YAML, its SHA-256 and the output_version stay the same, and the layered file moves to history with status superseded and kind layered_edition.
